testflight.whats_new:
Thanks for trying King Walk! Chess puzzles that adapt to you: solve one and the next gets harder, miss one and it eases off. Walk your king from Pawn rank up to King.

Things to try:
• Solve a few puzzles. Tap or drag the pieces. Stuck? Take a hint.
• Rank streaks, under Progress: 15 puzzles in a row, no hints, one miss and you're out.
• Share your progress after a puzzle.
• Game Center: leaderboards, achievements, and challenges to send a friend.
• The widget, on your home screen or Lock Screen.
• Turn your phone sideways, try dark mode, or switch your phone's language.

Tell me anything that's broken, confusing or no fun. Screenshots help.
